verdict.rationale: Typesense describes itself as a typo-tolerant search engine with typo-tolerant keyword search built in (docs-25, docs-40, docs-49). A hands-on user praised its fuzzy text matching (comm-12). The ranking guide includes a dedicated 'Tuning Typo Tolerance' section (docs-10), and sane defaults come with runtime controls for tuning (docs-47). Missing for 10: specifics of the tuning knobs (e.g. typo thresholds, per-field or word-length rules, prefix behavior), since the evidence only shows a section heading; detail on accent and non-English typo handling, which users raised as open questions.
